blurb: Charleston Harbor Marina provides premier dockage with deep-water access on the Cooper River, between Shem Creek and the USS Yorktown. It offers both transient and seasonal boat slips with a waterfront setting and easy access to Charleston city attractions. Amenities include a pool, marine store, and fuel dock.
